name: WITS Corp.
summary: WITS Corp., together with its subsidiaries, provides information technology (IT) services in China, Taiwan, Japan, and internationally. The company offers software research and development, and testing; system operations and maintenance; and software and technology consulting services that delivers artificial intelligence, big data, blockchain, cloud services, IoT, and information security. It also provides digital transformation consultation and solution services; integration of digital tools and platforms; carbon neutrality solutions; business process outsourcing services for telemarketing, client service centers, data centers, financial and HR operations, member applications and services,…
